response.rationale: A and B overlap, but they don't name the same capability. Both are anchored on RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1, "export class RinkService {"). Both include membership free-session entitlement. A also covers a second concern, unpaid booking expiry. A's community supports that wider scope because it includes BookingRepository (node 2e3c5728fffb0180, fan-in 12) and PuckPayClient, which point to booking and payment lifecycle handling. B's scope is the business component (DomainError, RinkService, ClubService, ReportService, IceMonitorService) and names only the entitlement part. So B is a subset of A. Confidence is moderate because the only code visible is the class declaration. Neither the entitlement logic nor the expiry logic can be checked directly.
